# Data Description

Analyze	taxi demand	patterns:	Specifically	show	how	these patterns	
(start	time,	trip	length,	start	and	end	location,	price,	average	idle	time	between	trips,	and	so	on)	for	the	
given	 sample	 varies in	 different	 spatio-temporal	 resolution (i.e.,	 census	 tract vs. varying hexagon	
diameter	and/or	temporal	bin	sizes).	Give	possible	reasons	for	the	observed	patterns.	
Furthermore,	can	you	identify	spatial	hot	spots	 for	trip	demand	using	Gaussian	Mixture	Models (i.e.,	
using	Spatial	Kernel	Density	Estimation)?
